entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please state the reason for your call.
Yeah, hi. I want to return a VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's not working properly.
Thank you for calling, I can help you with that. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
Thank you. Let me pull up your order. Okay, I see your purchase of the VeloBand Pulse on [date of purchase]. Can you tell me what issues you are experiencing with it?
The heart rate monitor is completely off. It's giving me readings that are impossible. I need to return it and get my money back. This is ridiculous!

I understand your frustration. I've checked your order and I see the purchase date was 15 days ago. Our return policy states that returns are accepted within a 10-day return window from the date of purchase.
What? Ten days? Seriously? I just got it! That's a terrible policy! I want a refund! I need my money back, not some excuse!

I understand your disappointment. While a full refund is outside of our policy due to the timeframe, let me see what options are available. I can offer you store credit for the value of the VeloBand Pulse. This will allow you to purchase another product from our store.
Store credit? I don't want store credit! I want my money back! This whole thing is a waste of time. Is there anything else you can do? Some kind of policy exception, maybe?
I understand. While I can't make a policy exception for a full refund in this case, let me check with my supervisor to see if there are any other options. Please hold for a moment.

Thank you for your patience. I've spoken with my supervisor. While we cannot offer a full refund, we can offer the store credit, plus a discount on your next VeloFit purchase as a gesture of goodwill due to the inconvenience you experienced with the VeloBand Pulse. Would that be acceptable?
A discount too? Okay, alright. That's… better. I guess I can use store credit and a discount. Fine. Do that.
Great. I've applied the store credit to your account, and the discount code has been sent to your email address. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks for actually helping. Appreciate you going the extra mile.
You're welcome! We appreciate your business with VeloFit. Have a great day!
